statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents can request additional input mid-processing by transitioning a task to the input-required state

statements.subject: task
statements.description: The generated taskId MUST be included in the Task object returned to the client; Agents MUST generate a unique taskId for each new task they create

statements.subject: task
statements.description: A contextId logically groups multiple Task objects and Message objects that are part of the same conversational context; if an agent generates a new contextId, it MUST be included in the response (either Task or Message)

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Agents MAY generate a new contextId when processing a Message that does not include a contextId field; if generated, it MUST be included in the response (either Task or Message); clients MAY include the contextId in subsequent messages to indicate continuation of a previous interaction

statements.subject: message
statements.description: When a client includes a taskId in a Message, it MUST reference an existing task; clients MAY use taskId (with or without contextId) to continue or refine a specific task

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Clients SHOULD use the referenceTaskIds field in Message to explicitly reference related tasks

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents can request additional input mid-processing by transitioning a task to the input-required state
actions: Agent transitions task to input-required state
Agent signals to client that additional input is required

statements.subject: task
statements.description: The client continues the interaction by sending a new message with the same taskId and contextId
statements.pre_cond: task.state = TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED & message.taskId = task.taskId & message.contextId = task.contextId
actions: Client sends new message with same taskId and contextId

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents MUST reject messages containing mismatching contextId and taskId (i.e., the provided contextId is different from that of the referenced Task)
statements.pre_cond: message.taskId != null & message.contextId != null & task.taskId = message.taskId & message.contextId != task.contextId
actions: Agent rejects the message with an error

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents MUST return a TaskNotFoundError if the provided taskId does not correspond to an existing task

statements.subject: context
statements.description: If an agent cannot accept a client-provided contextId, it MUST reject the request with an error and MUST NOT generate a new contextId for the response
actions: Agent rejects the request with an error
Agent does not generate a new contextId for the response

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents MUST infer contextId from the task if only taskId is provided
actions: Agent resolves the referenced task by message.taskId
Agent infers effective contextId from the referenced task's contextId
